shared_elements: row/file of figures facing the same direction (procession)
horizontal register of figures along a wall face
low-relief carved wall surface as the depicted subject
justification: Both depict files of robed human figures in strict profile, one behind another in a continuous horizontal register on a relief wall, with a shared convention of uniform stance, headgear and overlapping ranks; A's staircase facade also carries the same kind of processional bands. The main differences in content are that A additionally shows architecture (columns, parapets, crenellations) and an animal combat with lion and bull, and shows everything in miniature panoramic view, whereas B isolates a single large-scale scene of attendants carrying bowls and vessels toward a larger frontal-staffed figure, a specific offering relationship absent from A.
